label_basis: Requested domain goals, including conditional alternatives and requests disallowed by policy. Labels describe test design, not execution success.

retail.item_change: Change ordered product options; includes pending-item modification and delivered-item exchange, including rejected requests.
retail.order_cancellation: Request cancellation of an order or selected items, including conditional or withdrawn requests.
retail.return_refund: Request a return or refund for received items, including requests rejected by policy.
retail.order_address_change: Change the shipping address of an existing order.
retail.profile_address_change: Change the default address in the user profile.
retail.payment_change: Change or split payment on an existing order; includes prohibited split-payment requests.
retail.information_request: Explicit independent request for product, order, profile, tracking, or balance information; routine lookup and transaction totals are not counted separately.
retail.order_creation_request: Ask the retail agent to place or recreate an order. This is outside the listed retail capabilities.
retail.order_reinstatement_request: Ask to undo an order cancellation. This is outside the listed retail capabilities.

airline.booking: Request a new flight reservation, including cancellation and rebooking alternatives.
airline.flight_change: Request changes to flight date, route, or flight selection on a reservation, including disallowed changes.
airline.cabin_change: Request a cabin upgrade or downgrade, including unsupported partial changes.
airline.baggage_change: Request adding or removing checked bags; includes disallowed removal.
airline.passenger_change: Request changing passenger details or passenger count; includes prohibited count changes.
airline.cancellation: Request reservation cancellation/refund, whether eligible, rejected, or conditional.
airline.insurance_change: Request adding, removing, or refunding insurance after booking; these requests are disallowed.
airline.compensation: Request or discuss compensation for a delayed/cancelled flight, including ineligible claims.
airline.information_request: Independent request for reservation, allowance, balance, or flight information; routine lookup to perform another request is not counted separately.
